# Transporeon: Telematics API (for GPS providers)

- **Product:** Transporeon: Telematics API (for GPS providers) (Transportation family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** Bearer token. Declared security schemes: bearerAuth.
- **Access:** Fleet management (GPS) providers.
- **To call it you would need:** a telematics provider token; the API receives vehicle positions.
- **Documented servers:** `https://api.sixfold.com/v1`.
- **Definition:** [transporeon/sixfold-v1-telematics-sixfold-documentation-api-yaml](https://api.sixfold.com/v1/telematics/sixfold/documentation/api.yaml) (API for FMS providers, version 1.0.0). Documentation: https://transporeon-hcskb.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ADPD/pages/468484099/Telematics+for+GPS+Providers.

## Position and temperature data

| Method | Path | Disposition | Summary | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/telematics/sixfold/positions` | `reference` | Post list of vehicle statuses and temperatures. | body: application/json |
